notes.title: Version 1.2.0 (2025091801), 9/18/24
notes.notes:
Now on Mac!
 Improved Career Seasons List (more information, more room)
 Career Teams List, fixed sorting by won-lost percentage
 Fixed missing User Manual on home screen

notes.title: Update 2025091601
notes.notes:
The biggest change in this update is that you can now convert 2024 careers to 2025!  Continue your ongoing career and enjoy the vast improvements of PSF 2025!

Full notes:
- Huge, you can now migrate 2024 careers!
- Restored the Player Card 'Career History' button, now works properly
- New user options for viewing transactions
- New user option for season Passing Leaders (ratings or yards)
- Several new user options under the 'Career' tab
- Added an optional logo to Box Scoreboards, user can turn it on and off
- Several improvements to scoreboards
- Cleaned up 'common_anim.png'
- Corrected the 1968 Combined Leagues schedule
- Added Game Settings button to Animation Screen in 'Watch Live Sim'
